newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end off after Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end off after Dow rally.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures finished mostly down Monday in activity that one trader called choppy but uneventful, despite a brief, late rally driven by a higher Dow Jones Industrial Average.
After an uneven morning, Standard & Poor's 500 stock index futures hit an intraday high of 742.50 in mid-afternoon.
"That was all led not by the bonds, but by the Dow," said one trader. "The blue chips were leading the way.... Boy, the cash came pouring in, buy programs came in and jetted us up."
The Dow then sold off and S&P 500s followed it down, traders said.
The Dow ended down 1.12 at 6,346.91 after its rally.
Support for S&P 500s was seen at 737.00 on the day. For Tuesday, another trader said technicals point to an overbought situation.
He said he was looking for resistance at 745.30 and the previous contract high of 745.50, with support again expected at around 737.00.
"We're looking at double bottom now," the trader said.
Below that, other support levels were pegged at 734.10 and 732.65, the trader said.
Activity was light as traders looked toward Tuesday's scheduled release of October U.S. housing starts, forecast to rise to an annualized 1.443 million units from September's 1.438 million.

Dec S&P 500s fell 0.50 points to close pit trade at 740.35, Midcap 400s fell 0.20 to 253.50, Value Lines rose 0.80 to 670.40, NYSE Composites fell 0.25 to 391.35, NASDAQ 100 futures fell 6.50 to 799.25, and the Nikkei 225 fell 215.00 to 20,805.0. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
